content: Further, at the time of writing this paper, new multilingual pre-trained models and Transformer architectures have become available. It would not come as a surprise that these new resources and systems –e.g., XLM-RoBERTa BIBREF19 or BETO BIBREF20, a BERT model fully pre-trained on Spanish texts– further advanced the state of the art in this task.
